safeguard: Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key charges once
default_label: Keys are saved under the source account

variants.label: Idempotency keys are never saved
variants.root_cause: record_transfer() never saves the idempotency key, so find_transfer() never finds the earlier transfer and every retry moves money again.

variants.label: The lookup builds its key in the wrong order
variants.root_cause: find_transfer() looks up (key, requester) while record_transfer() stores (requester, key), so retries never match and money moves again.

variants.label: Keys are saved under the destination account
variants.root_cause: record_transfer() stores idempotency keys under the destination account while find_transfer() looks them up by requester, so retries are never matched and money moves again.
